title: conyza senecioides
intro: Conyza senecioides, commonly known as fetid marigold, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties that can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Conyza senecioides include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource for traditional medicine.
